$comment: Deterministic intake -> client.config.json mapping for fb-ads-agent. The /create-fb-ads-agent skill collects the Tier-1/Tier-2 intake into a FLAT answers.json ({ "<entry-id>": <value> }); scripts/build-config.mjs maps those answers through these entries into the nested config, fail-closed (unknown answer / missing required / bad type => exit 1). The LLM transcribes flat values only; it NEVER hand-writes the nested config JSON. answers.json is retained in the agent dir as the audit artifact, and verify-acceptance.mjs rebuilds config.acceptance from it: criteria are read-only to the executing agent, changing one means a human re-runs intake.

entries.question: TIER 1 - Client display name?
TIER 2 - Folder slug (lowercase, a-z0-9-)? Blank = derive from the name.
TIER 1 - Landing page: the real destination URL for every ad (never a homepage guess).
TIER 2 - Country codes to target (comma-separated). Default US-only.
TIER 1 - Meta ad account id (act_<number>).
TIER 1 - Facebook page id the ads run under.
TIER 2 - Instagram actor id (optional; IG placements). Blank = omit.
TIER 1 - Env NAME holding the Meta token (value never in config).
TIER 1 - Testing ad set id for IMAGE ads.
TIER 1 (only if running video) - Testing ad set id for VIDEO ads.
TIER 1 - Testing campaign id (new creative lands here PAUSED).
TIER 1 - Winners campaign id (CBO).
TIER 1 - Conversion action type used to count leads (offsite_conversion.custom.<id> or lead).
STRUCTURE - Multi-audience? JSON array of segments [{name, landing_page, adsets:{static,video}, campaigns:{testing,winners}}]. Blank = single segment (the default).
TIER 2 - Image creatives per day (default 10).
TIER 2 - Video creatives per day (default 5 if running video, else 0).
TIER 2 - Image generation model.
TIER 2 - Video generation model (REQUIRED by the schema if videos_per_day >= 1).
TIER 2 - url_tags template for creatives.
TIER 2 (you draft from the landing page) - Creative layout/vibe tags as JSON: [{tag, media_type, rules[], persona_key?, insight_key?, fixed_prompt?, segment?}].
TIER 2 (you draft) - Audience axis as JSON: [{key, descriptor}].
TIER 2 (you draft) - Message/pain-point axis as JSON: [{key, pain_point}].
TIER 2 (you draft from the page's value prop) - Brand mission, one line.
TIER 2 (you draft) - Who the brand sells to.
TIER 2 (you draft) - Brand tone of voice.
TIER 2 (you draft) - Message pillars, comma-separated.
TIER 2 - Generation rules (logo policy, stock-photo policy, ...), comma-separated. Verify checks that at least one exists.
entries.default: Do not include any logos or brand marks in the image

entries.question: TIER 2 - Never render or mention the brand name in ad copy/images? (yes/no)
TIER 1 - Target cost per lead (the kill/promote pivot).
TIER 2 - Optimizer lookback window in days (default 14).
TIER 2 - Minimum ad age before it can be judged (default 36).
TIER 2 - Minimum spend before an ad can be judged (default 35).
TIER 2 - Kill a zero-conversion ad after spend > this x target_cpl (default 1.5).
TIER 2 - Kill an ad whose CPL exceeds this x target_cpl (default 1.5).
TIER 2 - Keep any ad with a conversion within this many days (house standard, default 3).
TIER 1 - Hard CPA cap: ABSOLUTE cost-per-conversion ceiling that kills an ad regardless of recent conversions (the runaway-spend guard). Ask the client's real number; leave empty to disable.

TIER 2 - Kill action: PAUSE (default) or DELETE. Paused ads still count toward Meta's ad-per-ad-set cap; pick DELETE when the testing ad set is capacity-blocked (deleted ads are auto-archived, reporting kept).
TIER 2 - Enable the CTR floor rule (zero-conversion tiebreaker only)? (yes/no, default yes)
TIER 2 - CTR floor (default 0.01 = 1%).
TIER 2 - Cap on pauses per run (default 15).
TIER 2 - Cap on promotions per run (default 10).
STRUCTURE - Promote a testing ad on its FIRST conversion (high-volume accounts)? (yes/no, default no = normal testing/winners flow.)
TIER 2 - Dashboard page title (default '<client name> - Meta Ads').
TIER 2 - Dashboard logo-badge initials (default: first letters of the client name).
TIER 2 - Dashboard primary brand color (#rrggbb).
TIER 2 - Dashboard accent brand color (#rrggbb).
ACCEPTANCE - What condition must become true for this agent to be done? (default: verify exits 0, every code criterion PASS, every human criterion PARKED with evidence.)
entries.default: `node factory.mjs verify <agent-dir>` exits 0: every code acceptance criterion is PASS against the run's own artifacts (paused-publish, batch-volume, destination-clean, copy-unique, not-blocked) and every human criterion is PARKED at its named gate with a signed-off review artifact. A blocked run (pipeline exit 2, report.json blocked=true) is never done.

entries.question: ACCEPTANCE - How many fix->verify attempts before the goal loop stops and reports FAIL? (default 3)

ACCEPTANCE - The criteria array as JSON. Start from the vertical default set (paused-publish, batch-volume, destination-clean, copy-unique, not-blocked as verifier:'code'; creative-review gate:'reviewer' and vision-qa gate:'vision-qa' as verifier:'human') in client.config.example.json and edit with the operator. Every code criterion needs a registered check in scripts/verify-acceptance.registry.mjs (unknown ids FAIL closed) and a negativeCase. A human criterion is PARKED, never self-graded.
